title: Freemax X1-D Mesh Coil 0.15ohm 5 Pack
description: FreeMax’s X-series mesh coils feature FM COILTECH5.0/Double-D Mesh technology. This innovative approach to coil building uses a parallel mesh structure with two single mesh coils connected in parallel, which heats up e-liquid faster while keeping the coils stable, producing immaculate flavour and incredible clouds from your favourite e-liquid. This pack contain 5 x 0.15ohm X1-D coils, recommended wattage 40-80W
